name: Autonomous Repair & Patch Verification
purpose: Perform an explicitly authorized repair inside an isolated workspace and produce a verified patch artifact.
allowed: apply bounded patch inside authorized scope
carry the exact candidate patch as data on VERIFIED results

external_verification.fingerprint_binding: evidence_fingerprint must match the canonical fingerprint of the external executor, command, run identity, source commit, result fingerprint and reported verification outcomes.
external_verification.failure_policy: Missing or mismatched non-Python verification metadata must not produce VERIFIED.

t21_handoff.fingerprint_rule: SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 candidate_patch bytes must match RepairResult.patch_fingerprint and the T21 request repair_fingerprint.
t21_handoff.baseline_rule: T21 must verify baseline_fingerprint against the live source tree before applying a patch.
t21_handoff.final_tree_rule: T21 must verify final_tree_fingerprint after applying the exact candidate patch.
t21_handoff.path_rule: Patch paths, RepairResult.changed_paths and T21 authorized changed_paths must match exactly.
t21_handoff.authority_rule: T18 authorizes; T20 verifies in an isolated workspace and carries candidate patch data only when VERIFIED. T20 does not authorize Git writes, mutate the main repository, or publish to GitHub.

deep_audit.01_purpose: Bounded authorized repair and patch verification.
deep_audit.02_capability_completeness: Repair, scope, patch, workspace, verification and evidence controls.
deep_audit.03_inputs: T03, T17, T18, T19 and repository baseline evidence.
deep_audit.04_outputs: Repair result, verification evidence and candidate patch data on VERIFIED results.
deep_audit.06_evidence_dependency: T17 impact, T19 diagnosis and test plan.
deep_audit.08_downstream_consumers: T21 Git coordination, deployment and review boundaries.
deep_audit.09_failure_modes: Authorization, scope, baseline, patch, syntax, verification and rollback failures.
deep_audit.10_security_boundary: AI output is untrusted candidate data.
deep_audit.11_determinism: Scope, identity and final verdict are deterministic.
deep_audit.13_recovery: Failed repairs are discarded from isolated workspace.
deep_audit.14_gpt_limitation_coverage: Hallucination, stale context, over-broad edits and false success are controlled.
deep_audit.16_cross_chat_continuity: Repair fingerprints and receipts preserve continuity.
deep_audit.18_write_capability: Only isolated bounded workspace and evidence artifacts.
deep_audit.20_observability: Repair, authorization, scope and verification fingerprints.
deep_audit.21_integration_contract: T20 verifies in isolation; T21 independently revalidates and applies the verified candidate under T18 authorization.
deep_audit.22_missing_layers: Publication, deployment and learning remain separate.
deep_audit.24_idempotency_replay_safety: Repair identity includes authorization and baseline fingerprints.
deep_audit.25_versioning_migration_compatibility: Schema and policy versions are explicit.
deep_audit.26_adversarial_red_team_coverage: Scope escape, malicious patch and policy bypass are blocked.
